html:
Kyivan Rus' was the first East Slavic state, ruled from Kyiv by the Rurikid princes from the late 800s to 1240. It is on the map for 900 and 1000; the chart's bar is Kievan Rus'.

In 882 Oleg moved south from Novgorod and took Kyiv, joining the north and south of the route from the Varangians to the Greeks. The princes collected tribute in furs, wax and slaves and sold it in Constantinople. Sviatoslav destroyed the Khazar Khaganate in the 960s.

His son Vladimir the Great took Christianity from Byzantium around 988. Under Yaroslav the Wise Kyiv got the Saint Sophia Cathedral and a written law code, and his children married into the royal houses of Europe. After 1100 the state broke into rival principalities, and the Mongols took Kyiv in 1240.
sum: Kyivan Rus' was the first East Slavic state, ruled from Kyiv by the Rurikid princes from the late 800s to 1240. It is on the map for 900 and 1000; the chart's bar is Kievan Rus'.
